name: goldnead/statamic-invoices
description: Invoices for statamic-payments: a gapless number per brand, VAT by the buyer's country, reverse charge, and a document that never changes.

suggest.ext-zip: Build the PDF archive of a period (Invoice export utility, invoices:export pdf)
suggest.goldnead/statamic-email-templates: Let editors write the invoice mail in the Control Panel (template invoices-invoice); the PDF stays attached
suggest.goldnead/statamic-insights: Show documents issued, net, gross and VAT on the Insights dashboard, split by kind, buyer country and tax rate
suggest.goldnead/statamic-webhook-manager: Offer issued invoices, credit notes and deliveries as triggers for outbound webhooks (bookkeeping, a CRM); picked up automatically where it is installed
